decision: Document preparation capacity at NTP: process 4, mechanical 8, piping 8, electrical 4, I&C 5, civil 5, structural 2, HVAC 1, HSE 2, commissioning 1, general 2, project control 1 FTE (43 FTE, 7.5 h / day). Checking, 3D modelling, vendor document review and site support are staffed in addition.
rationale: Smallest team with non-negative EWP and PWP float in the levelled timeline: with 4 mechanical FTE the early requisitions (MR-ME-001/003/009/012/015/016/021) were 8-16 wd late; with 4 civil FTE the GT and ST foundations (EWP-01-CV-02, EWP-02-CV-02) were late.
title: Engineering staffing for document preparation (levelled workflow timeline)
